slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review states that DHIS2 is used nationally in Nigeria for aggregate HMIS reporting, with rural primary healthcare clinics' data collated on paper and entered at LGA or district level; no date is given for the position, so the document's published date is used.

Data Landscapers' review states that rural primary healthcare clinics in Nigeria record patient data on paper registers, citing studies that found 100% reliance on paper files and 0% electronic records in surveyed PHCs and national EHR adoption of about 18%; it says pilots are isolated and donor-driven and do not reach most of about 30,000 rural PHCs. Undated in the text, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: national aggregate reporting; primary clinics' data entered at LGA/district level from paper

systems.platform: DHIS2, as the passage groups it

systems.tiers: not in surveyed primary healthcare clinics; national adoption about 18%

note: Passages file. The document is an AI-assisted compilation by its author; its Nigeria clinic row cites BMC Public Health 2025, a 2024 PHC records assessment and the GJMS 2025 EHR barriers paper as its sources.
